open_points.subject: store.open_store startup cleanup
open_points.text: “The store's own temporary files … are removed, and nothing else is” contradicts A18 rule 4 and State 4 step 4, which require removal of “value bytes no record names” at startup.
open_points.question: Must open_store remove unreferenced content-addressed value bytes at startup, and does a failure to remove them stop startup?
options: Remove temporary files and unreferenced value bytes; fail startup if required cleanup fails
Remove unreferenced value bytes best-effort without failing startup
open_points.default_guess: Follow A18 and State 4: remove temporary files and unreferenced value bytes, and fail startup on an unhandled cleanup error.

open_points.subject: bindings.check_installed_instances manifest validation
open_points.text: “an unreadable record, or one failing a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5), fails at its service”
open_points.question: Which exact A08 rule 5 checks are checks of the service record itself during startup when check_installed_instances has no operation name or proposed ports?
options: Only file/JSON shape, service identity, capabilities presence and duplicate capability names
Validate every capability entry's effect class, exposure and idempotency syntax too
Only parse enough instance data to compare credential and required-header names
open_points.default_guess: Apply only service-level structural checks needed to read the selected instance: file/JSON shape, service identity, capabilities presence and duplicate capability names.

open_points.subject: canonical_values.fit_port_value file media types
open_points.text: “for a file, the schema check is its media type against the port's”
open_points.question: How are a candidate file's media type and the port's declared media type compared: exact text, case-insensitive type/subtype with parameters ignored, or another normalization rule?
options: Case-insensitive type/subtype equality with parameters ignored, as for HTTP responses
Case-insensitive equality of the complete media-type text
open_points.default_guess: Use exact string equality for stored file facts; keep A09's special HTTP Content-Type comparison separate.

open_points.subject: functions.add_trial_case port coverage
open_points.text: “Fit in port name order — presence, carriage, schema, size”
open_points.question: Must authored trial inputs contain exactly every contract input and no extra names, and, when expected_outputs is present, must it contain exactly every contract output rather than a partial expected set? Also, where are unexpected names ordered among failures?
options: Require exact input and expected-output maps; reject unexpected names before per-port checks
Require exact maps; check declared ports first and unexpected names afterward
Allow partial expected outputs and ignore or reject extra inputs separately
open_points.default_guess: Require exact maps whenever present, reject unexpected names, and check unexpected names before per-port fit checks.

open_points.subject: EffectAttempt resolution timestamp
open_points.question: When an EffectAttempt changes from unknown to applied or not_applied, is concluded_at preserved from the transport/recovery conclusion, overwritten with the owner's resolution time, or is a separate resolution timestamp required?
options: Preserve concluded_at and record only resolved_by
Overwrite concluded_at with the resolution time
Preserve concluded_at and add a distinct resolved_at timestamp
open_points.default_guess: Preserve concluded_at as the time the send became unknown and record only resolved_by, matching the fields currently defined.
